name: App Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Launch · Group · Bind · Inspect: all your apps and plugins in one theme-aware popup. Type to launch; sort apps into your own groups or by origin (your default apps, what came with Omarchy, what you added); give any app or app action a global shortcut on a key map that shows who owns every key; and open App info with path, package, size, install date and website. Widgets, plugins and tray apps have their own page, where widgets can be put into or taken out of the bar.
